children: New Delhi, Sept. 16 -- India Pesticides share price today: Shares of India Pesticides Limited rallied nearly 11.8% during Wednesday's intraday trading session after the agrochemical company announced approval for one of its key products in the United Kingdom and Argentina.
The BSE 500 stock has jumped 8.65% in two weeks, but it has declined around 15.25% in 2026 so far.

India Pesticides received technical equivalence approval for one of its insecticide products in the United Kingdom, announced the company in its BSE filing on Tuesday. The company has also successfully obtained registration for one of its herbicide products in Argentina.

As per the BSE filing, the regulatory approvals mark significant milestones in the company's international growth journey and strengthen its presence in the global agrochemical market.The approvals are expected to support the company's export growth and contribute positively to foreign exchange earnings for the country.

The stock was trading 10.66% higher at Rs.146.35 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.1,685.42 crore at 10:07 am on Wednesday, September 16. The stock had touched an intraday high of Rs.152.25 per share and an intraday low of Rs.136 per share.

India Pesticides stock touched its 52-week high of Rs.240.10 per share on September 8, 2025. The stock dipped to its 52-week low of Rs.124.65 per share on March 30, 2026. With a return on equity (ROE) of 16.79%, the stock value has surged around 8.25% in one week, 7.74% in two weeks and around 4.59% in six months. Meanwhile, the stock value has declined around 15.96% year to date (YTD) and 32% in one year.

The Uttar Pradesh-headquartered pesticides and agrochemicals firm reported a net profit of Rs.23.07 crore in the June quarter of financial year 2026-27. India Pesticides had reported a net profit of Rs.31.76 crore in the March quarter.

The company stock had delivered a net revenue of Rs.252.56 crore in Q1FY27 against Rs.266.15 crore reported in the March quarter. The company's earnings per share (EPS) declined to Rs.2.00 in Q1FY27 against Rs.2.60 in Q4FY26. Published by HT Digital Content Services with permission from MINT.
